statement:
∀ (red : Reduction.loc p →+* ZMod p) (eps : ZMod p →+* K),
 letI : Algebra (Reduction.loc p) K := (eps.comp red).toAlgebra
 letI : Algebra (ZMod p) K := eps.toAlgebra
 ∀ (fw : (K ⊗[Reduction.loc p] Reduction.MR p M) →ₗ[K]
       (K ⊗[ZMod p] ModN (Reduction.MR p M) p))
   (bw : (K ⊗[ZMod p] ModN (Reduction.MR p M) p) →ₗ[K]
       (K ⊗[Reduction.loc p] Reduction.MR p M)),
 fw.comp bw = LinearMap.id → bw.comp fw = LinearMap.id →
 ∃ Psi : (K ⊗[Reduction.loc p] Reduction.MR p M) ≃ₗ[K]
       (K ⊗[ZMod p] ModN (Reduction.MR p M) p),
 Psi.toLinearMap = fw ∧ Psi.symm.toLinearMap = bw
proof:
intro red eps
letI : Algebra (Reduction.loc p) K := (eps.comp red).toAlgebra
letI : Algebra (ZMod p) K := eps.toAlgebra
intro fw bw hfb hbf
let Psi : (K ⊗[Reduction.loc p] Reduction.MR p M) ≃ₗ[K]
    (K ⊗[ZMod p] ModN (Reduction.MR p M) p) :=
  LinearEquiv.ofLinear fw bw hfb hbf
exact ⟨Psi, rfl, rfl⟩
